_comment: Copy this to accounts.json to use more than one Claude subscription —
or just run ./install.sh, which writes this file for you.
Each account needs its OWN config directory: that directory is the only
thing that makes one Claude login distinct from another, so two entries
sharing one would silently be the same account twice.
These directories belong to this tool. Your own ~/.claude is never one of
them, and nothing that runs on a timer reads or writes it. The one command
that does is `claude-window switch`, which parks a separate login per
account under ~/.claude-switch/ and points your own Claude Code at one.
Log in to each with:  CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-2 claude   then /login
Logging in sends no message, so it never starts a usage window.
